firstPlayerRule: The most enthusiastic worker is Monday’s first Shift Supervisor.
clarifications: The Shift Supervisor reveals and places one Product tile after the team discusses where it belongs.
The role rotates clockwise after each tile.
During the final customer rush, the whole team searches simultaneously.
